root_cause: Default text-mode fixture writes translate LF to CRLF on Windows. The index correctly hashes physical bytes, while supplied in-memory pages hash the original LF UTF-8 string. The differing source versions correctly fail strict evidence binding.

reproduction.kind: Controlled simulation of default Windows text-mode newline translation; not native Windows verification.
reproduction.method: Temporarily wrap pathlib.Path.write_text: only when newline is None, replace LF with CRLF, then call the original writer with newline="". No product function or assertion is mocked.

change.description: Replace five fixture text-write call sites with explicit UTF-8 write_bytes so indexed files and captured-page hash inputs are byte-identical across platforms. Manual fixture encoding is explicit as well.

limitations: This local fix verification is not a completed native Windows workflow. The next Windows full regression run must verify the candidate.
No full local suite was rerun for this fixture-only portability fix; production semantics and all existing correctness assertions remain unchanged.
No model, provider, source upload, build, release or network request occurred in this audit.
